caseNameFull: Cudahy Packing Co. v. Holland, Administrator of the Wage and Hour Division, U. S. Department of Labor
attorneys: Mr. William C. Green for petitioner. Solicitor General Fahy for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The petition for writ of certiorari is granted. The judgment is reversed on the authority of Cudahy Packing Co. v. Holland, ante, p. 357. Mr. Justice Murphy took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
